chunks: Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: “They ask you what has been made lawful for them. Say: Lawful to you are all good things, and what you have taught of hunting animals, trained as hounds, teaching them from what Allah has taught you. So eat of what they catch for you, and mention the name of Allah upon it.”

key_terms.أَمْسَكْنَ: they caught or held the prey for you
key_terms.أُحِلَّ: has been made lawful or permissible
key_terms.اسْمَ اللَّهِ: the name of Allah, to be mentioned over the catch
key_terms.الطَّيِّبَاتُ: the good, pure, and wholesome things that are lawful to consume
key_terms.الْجَوَارِحِ: hunting animals or birds that seize prey
key_terms.مُكَلِّبِينَ: training animals for hunting, especially like hounds

ai.seo_question: What does Qur'an 5:4 say about eating game caught by trained hunting animals?
ai.summary: This verse explains that pure and wholesome things are lawful, including game caught by properly trained hunting animals. It also establishes the condition of mentioning the name of Allah upon the catch, highlighting both permissibility and religious discipline in lawful consumption.
